class: Any screen that states 'the value in force' (a limit, a threshold, a rate) from its own derivation beside the code that acts on it: the two drift on every case the derivation does not copy (time of day, strategy shape, plan overrides).
mechanism: Round 1 read the plan route's prefill; round 2 added a second derivation that missed expiry-day tightening, the 2x-credit stop and unlimited max loss; round 3 asked the evaluator itself.

first_seen.where: plan card, trade-rules editor (GC-ICFIX issue 2, red twice, then a third time)
first_seen.evidence: Round 1: card Target 50 / Stop 50 while the last day acts at 80 / 40. Round 2: strangle at 13:00, 80 -> 64.0 and 40 -> 32.0 missed. Third time: the trade-rules editor showed 30 while the check acted at 50 (plan Target over the profit trigger). Opus grid after the fix: 35,856 old-vs-new comparisons, 0 mismatches.

fix: limits_now inside the evaluator, sent on the rule-check reply; the screen shows that and derives nothing; the editor shows the applied view.

detection.note: Unguarded: no named check is confirmed to cover the class; the proof was one real run, not a standing check. The grid was a one-off review run.
